license: UK Open Government Licence (OGL), subject to HM Land Registry/Ordnance Survey attribution and conditions of use

field_evidence.publication_version: HM Land Registry's current public download page states that this INSPIRE release was published on 6 September 2026 and remains available until the next monthly update.
field_evidence.ashford_file_listing: The official download inventory explicitly lists Ashford Borough Council with a downloadable GML file.
field_evidence.dataset_scope: INSPIRE Index Polygons show the position and indicative extent of registered freehold properties in England and Wales and each polygon carries a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title.
field_evidence.format: The Ashford local-authority distribution is supplied as GML and requires GIS tooling to inspect or integrate.
field_evidence.legal_extent_limit: HM Land Registry states that the extent of land contained in any registered title cannot be established from INSPIRE Index Polygons; the polygons are indicative.
field_evidence.transport_result: The current 6 September 2026 inventory is readable through the public/no-login search window, but the direct Ashford GML link could not be resolved by the available transport because the page open path enters a redirect loop and the underlying file URL is not exposed to this transport.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: This local-authority GML inventory is source-area evidence only. Without a target-specific Forge Cottage INSPIRE ID/polygon selected and bound by local OpenCode, no canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted.
